FM 卫星上行需亚音：多数 67.0 Hz；SO-50 需先发 74.4 Hz: FM satellites need an uplink tone: 67.0 Hz for most; SO-50 must first be activated with 74.4 Hz and then switched to 67.0 Hz.
上行 UHF、下行 VHF（如 AO-73）：上行 USB、下行 LSB。: Uplink on UHF, downlink on VHF (e.g. AO-73): uplink USB, downlink LSB.
上行 VHF、下行 UHF（如 FO-29）：上行 USB、下行 LSB。: Uplink on VHF, downlink on UHF (e.g. FO-29): uplink USB, downlink LSB.
倒置转发器：上行频率高的一端对应下行频率低的一端，调谐方向相反。: Inverting transponder: the high end of the uplink corresponds to the low end of the downlink, so tuning runs in the opposite direction.
先在「业余卫星」页查下次过境时间与最大仰角，提前 5 分钟到场准备。: First check the time of the next pass and its maximum elevation on the "Amateur satellites" page; be ready on station 5 minutes early.
只报呼号、信号报告（59 / 599）与网格坐标，不做长篇闲聊。: Give only the callsign, signal report (59 / 599) and grid locator — no long rag-chews.
多人抢用同一转发器时，让信号弱、仰角低（即将出窗）的台优先。: When several stations compete for the same transponder, give priority to weak stations at low elevation (about to leave the window).
尽量用能同时收发的电台（全双工），否则边发边收会漏听。: Use a radio that can transmit and receive simultaneously (full duplex) if possible; otherwise you will miss what is said while you transmit.
手持八木天线指向卫星，线性卫星需旋转天线匹配极化方向。: Point a handheld Yagi at the satellite; for linear satellites rotate the antenna to match the polarisation.
把电台调在下行频率守听，确认卫星已过境、转发器有人使用。: Tune the radio to the downlink frequency and listen, to confirm the satellite has risen and the transponder is in use.
报信号报告（59）与 Maidenhead 网格坐标，确认对方收到。: Give your signal report (59) and Maidenhead grid locator, and confirm that the other station received you.
线性转发器固定「上行 USB → 下行 LSB」，收发边带相反；记不住就用 CW: Linear transponders are fixed as "uplink USB → downlink LSB": the sidebands are opposite; if you cannot remember, CW is the simplest option.
线性转发器是透明转发，你的上行会立刻从下行转发出来，能听到自己。: A linear transponder retransmits transparently: your uplink is immediately retransmitted on the downlink, so you can hear yourself.

FM satellites need only ±3–5 kHz, while linear transponders require tracking both directions throughout the pass.
趁空隙只报自己的呼号（如「BG1ABC」），等待别人点你。: In a gap, give only your own callsign (e.g. "BG1ABC") and wait for someone to call you.
过境接近（AOS）时卫星靠近，接收到的下行频率偏高，需把接收频率向上微调（约 +: At acquisition of signal (AOS) the satellite is approaching, so the received downlink frequency is high; tune the receive frequency up (about +3–5 kHz).
过境最高点（TCA）多普勒归零，使用标称频率。: At time of closest approach (TCA) the Doppler shift is zero; use the nominal frequency.
过境远离（LOS）时卫星远离，接收到的下行频率偏低，需把接收频率向下微调。: At loss of signal (LOS) the satellite is receding, so the received downlink frequency is low; tune the receive frequency down.
通联务必简短，结束报 73 并让出信道给其他人。: Keep the contact short: finish with 73 and yield the channel to others.
